bio_en: Dignāga was an Indian Buddhist thinker associated with Yogācāra and the development of Buddhist logic. His writings examine perception, inference and the objects of cognition. Chinese translations of his works, including the Investigation of the Object of Cognition, contributed to the study of consciousness and reasoning in East Asian Buddhism.
bio_summary: 陳那為印度佛教因明大家，立現量、比量之辨，開新因明之學。兼治唯識，漢譯《觀所緣緣論》等存其論說。
name: 陳那
